mapper.insert: insert ignore into cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log (topic_id, member_id, coupon_id, created_at) values (#{topicId}, #{memberId}, #{couponId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log where topic_id = #{topicId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select coupon_id from cms_topic_completion_coupon_reward_log where topic_id = #{topicId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
